info.title: loomloom
info.description: HTTP API for executing and managing loomloom AI work through CogFoundry.

get.description: Returns Market SkillBot listings owned by the authenticated creator, including pending review, rejected, published, and unlisted listings.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword matched against listing title and description.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned by the previous response.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort expression. Currently supports createdAt desc.

get.description: Returns one Market SkillBot owned by the authenticated creator, including private publishing state such as pending review, rejected, published, and unlisted. It does not expose workflow execution specs.

Returns version history for a Market SkillBot owned by the authenticated creator. The response includes status, review, pricing, source template, and hash metadata, but does not expose workflow execution specs.
Returns Market SkillBot calls for the authenticated creator, including execution and settlement projection plus matched creator earning when available. It does not expose funding action internals.

post.description: Withdraws a pending Market review request owned by the authenticated creator. For publish or update_version requests, the pending listing version becomes withdrawn and is no longer executable or sellable. For update_public_profile requests, the listing and published version are unchanged.
Uploads a controlled raw input asset through Product API. The content field is base64 encoded in JSON.
Uploads a flat JSONL execution input through Product API. The returned inputFileId is the only file ID accepted by template run APIs; inputAssetId values from /inputAssets:upload are not valid here.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword matched against listing title and description.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned by the previous response.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort expression. Currently supports createdAt desc.

post.description: Creates a new listing or publishes a new immutable listing version from a loomloom template version.

get.description: Returns one public Market SkillBot listing. Pending, rejected, unlisted, blocked, or otherwise non-public listings are not visible through this buyer-facing route.

post.summary: Submit Market SkillBot public profile update
post.description: Creates a pending review request for listing public profile fields only. It does not change execution version, input/output contract, pricing, sale status, or transaction facts before approval.

get.description: Downloads an Excel workbook for the public input schema of a Market SkillBot. The workbook is generated from the source loomloom template version behind the selected listing version.

parameters.name: listingVersionId
parameters.description: Market listing version ID. Defaults to the currently published version.

post.description: Requires confirm=true and a stable clientRequestId for the buyer-confirmed execution attempt. Returns Market transaction context plus loomloom run ID.
Requires confirm=true and a stable clientRequestId for the buyer-confirmed workbook execution attempt.
Returns estimated execution cost plus task-level creator fee. Final settlement follows actual loomloom execution cost plus billable task count times task_fixed_fee_t.

get.description: Lists model catalog entries for one step type. stepType is required to avoid mixed text/image/video catalogs.

parameters.name: stepType
parameters.description: Step type, for example text-generate, image-generate, or video-generate.

parameters.name: onlyAvailable
parameters.description: When false, include unavailable known models. Default true.

get.description: Returns official workbook-based templates exposed through the loomloom Public API.
Returns the caller's executable loomloom assets, including private templates and Market SkillBots.
Returns Market SkillBot calls for the authenticated buyer. It is a buyer-facing usage view, not a raw transaction or funding action API.
Returns one Market SkillBot call for the authenticated buyer. Funding actions and creator earning internals are not exposed.

parameters.name: marketUsage
parameters.description: Market usage ID, currently the run_transaction_id

get.summary: List loomloom runs with optional Market context
Get loomloom run detail with optional Market context

get.description: Returns result artifacts for one loomloom run. The caller's credential is forwarded to loomloom Core for access control.
Returns row-level input and result aggregation for one loomloom run. The caller's credential is forwarded to loomloom Core for access control.
Downloads an Excel workbook containing run inputs and results. The caller's credential is forwarded to loomloom Core for access control.
Returns private template summaries for the authenticated user. The response intentionally excludes workflow specs, hidden prompts, runtime config, and Market release package internals.

post.description: Creates a private template container. A runnable version is added separately with canonical_spec.

get.description: Returns one private template summary and its version summaries for the authenticated user. The response intentionally excludes canonical_spec, workflow definitions, hidden prompts, runtime config, source refs, and Market release package internals.
Returns immutable version summaries for one private template. The response intentionally excludes canonical_spec and executable workflow internals.

post.description: Saves an immutable private template version from a structured TemplateSpec canonical_spec object.
Estimates a private loomloom template version run using an uploaded JSONL input file. The response includes estimated cost and balance check and does not create a run.
Submits a run for an authenticated user's private loomloom template version. The request binds an explicit immutable version and input asset; it does not expose or accept workflow specs.
